1
EXTRAORDINARY REGISTERED NO. S-2771
PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF BALOCHISTAN
SECRETARIAT
THE BALOCHISTAN SPEAKER’S AND DEPUTY SPEAKER’S
(SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) ACT, 1975.
(BALOCHISTAN ACT NO.V OF 1975).
(Amended up to 9th October, 2014).
An Act to provide for the salaries, allowance and privileges of the
Speaker and Deputy Speaker of the Provincial Assembly of
Balochistan.
The bill was passed by the Balochistan Provincial Assembly on
02-07-1975 and after having received the assent of the Governor
of Balochistan, published as Act of the Provincial Assembly, in
th
the Balochistan Gazette (Extra-ordinary) dated 14 July, 1975.
